# Connectivity

Whether the host reaches an address, by ICMP ping. `osapi behavior get --name connectivity` and `osapi behavior method get` show the same.

## Method ping

| | |
| --- | --- |
| Name | ping |
| Verb | write |
| Description | Ping an address from the host |
| Detail | Sends three ICMP echo requests from the host and reports how many came back, and their round-trip times. A host that does not answer is 100% loss, not an error. It changes nothing, so it reports changed: false. On Linux the agent pings without root when net.ipv4.ping_group_range admits its group. |
| HTTP | POST |
| Route | /api/node/&#123;hostname&#125;/network/connectivity/ping |
| Permission | connectivity:execute |
| Command | [osapi client node network connectivity ping](../../../../usage/cli/client/node/network/connectivity/ping.md) |
| Input type | PingInput |
| Output type | PingResult |

### Input (1)

| FIELD | TYPE | REQUIRED | DESCRIPTION |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| address | string | yes | The IPv4 or IPv6 address to ping, or an @fact. reference that the agent resolves |

### Output (7)

| FIELD | TYPE | DESCRIPTION |
| --- | --- | --- |
| packets_sent | integer | Number of packets sent |
| packets_received | integer | Number of packets received |
| packet_loss | number | Percentage of packet loss |
| min_rtt | string | Minimum round-trip time in milliseconds, with two decimals. Absent when no reply came back. |
| avg_rtt | string | Average round-trip time in milliseconds, with two decimals. Absent when no reply came back. |
| max_rtt | string | Maximum round-trip time in milliseconds, with two decimals. Absent when no reply came back. |
| changed | boolean | Always false: a ping changes nothing on the host |
